aiDescription.summary: This joint resolution, under the Congressional Review Act, disapproves and voids the EPA rule (90 Fed. Reg. 55671, Dec. 3, 2025) that extended deadlines in Standards of Performance and Emissions Guidelines for the oil and natural gas sector. If enacted, it would remove nationwide those deadline extensions for new, reconstructed, modified, and existing sources, affecting owners and operators of oil and gas facilities.

description.text: A joint resolution providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Environmental Protection Agency relating to "Oil and Natural Gas Sector Climate Review: Extension of Deadlines in Standards of Performance for New, Reconstructed, and Modified Sources and Emissions Guidelines for Existing Sources".

impact.summary: The resolution would void the EPA rule (90 Fed. Reg. 55671) that extended deadlines in the Oil and Natural Gas Sector climate review, removing the agency's extension. This affects EPA enforcement and oil and gas operators (wells, pipelines, compressor stations, processing plants) and the state air agencies that implement Clean Air Act NSPS and Emissions Guidelines.

latestAction.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Environment and Public Works.
